title: Principles
description: The canonical list of principles. Hand-edited source of truth; principles/*.md is generated from it.

id.description: category number, a dot, then the number within the category

category.description: slug of an entry in categories

sources.description: Source labels as written in the research. Each label must resolve to a repo through labels in data/sources.json.

aliases.description: Old ids of principles that were merged into this one. They are no longer entries in principles; the site and principles/ keep a small redirect for each so old links still resolve.

id.description: the partner principle that overlaps with this one

difference.description: When to use this principle and how it differs from the partner. Shown on the principle's pages.

related_practices.description: Established practices that are not principles in this list (SOLID, DRY, the Law of Demeter and the like) but that this principle's skill applies. The skill has a Related practices entry, a self-check item and a reviewer check for each, all starting with its name; scripts/check-skills.py keeps them in step. Shown on the principle's pages.

name.description: The practice's usual name, as the skill writes it

guide.description: The developer-guide section that explains it, as a repo path with a heading anchor

see_also.description: Other principles the practice touches, such as the one that brakes it

research_run.description: id of the research run that introduced this principle
